cell_seed: unsigned integer from first 16 SHA256 hex digits of NUL-joined strings: RES510-v1, run_id, population, lift, horizon_days, treatment_arm, control_arm
conditional_track: fixed-five-fit entity-only bootstrap: same entity samples, average all five seed-specific differences with no seed resampling; conditional on these exact fitted pairs
decision_rule: benefit if upper < -1; harm if lower > 1; equivalence if lower >= -1 and upper <= 1; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE

dependency_status.RES-509: OPEN; PR27 DRAFT, no final scientific qualification

draw_order: all Bx5 seed indices from integers(0,5); then Bxn_plan entity indices via rng.choice(sorted-row-index positions in each plan, size=(B,32), replace=True), in declared plan order; concatenate plan blocks
independent_review: Outcome-blind independent agent method review supports shared factor sampling with limits; external scientific approval remains pending

monte_carlo.endpoint_bounds: order-statistic outer envelope: np.quantile(p-epsilon, method=lower) for lower endpoint; np.quantile(p+epsilon, method=higher) for upper endpoint; conservatively encloses generalized-inverse empirical CDF bounds; DKW+union across 648 CDFs is MC randomness only
monte_carlo.final_status: retain primary percentile classification only if all three runs have that classification and every run MC-envelope classification agrees; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE; no adaptive replicate extension or seed selection

multiplicity: 108 dependent per-cell intervals; no family-wise superiority or population/lift/horizon pooling
no_leakage: post-seal authority-only scoring; no fitting or learner invocation; verify split membership/disjointness and original firewall/seal records

original_replay.audit_diagnostic: same original per-replicate RNG seed-choice, but ONE shared plan sample per replicate; diagnostic 1000-replicate sensitivity, not canonical correction
original_replay.original_draw_order: per replicate seed-choice of 5 fitting-seed labels; independently sample plan blocks once PER selected seed occurrence
original_replay.rng_seed: first 8 SHA256 hex digits of NUL joined 292170, pooled, population,lift,horizon,treatment,control

primary_estimand: mean_s [sqrt(E_entity error_treatment_s^2) - sqrt(E_entity error_control_s^2)], conditional on original fitting dataset and upstream synthetic/teacher realization; empirical plan proportions fixed at 1/4
primary_resampling: crossed/product: independently resample five paired fitting-seed indices and one common plan-stratified entity sample; use same entity sample for every selected seed occurrence and both arms; mean seed-specific paired RMSE differences, kg

quantiles.confidence_scope: approximate per-cell percentile; not simultaneous scientific coverage

small_seed_qualification: INCONCLUSIVE for nominal random-seed population coverage: five fits do not establish exchangeability or seed-tail support; product bootstrap can inflate interaction variance; no finite-sample or conservative-coverage guarantee for RMSE
